title: Appeal received on a parked case ? appeal NOT accepted, case NOT reopened; message added as an update for the SAME agent | APPR | Controllable (Code 96) | Delay 6 to under 9 hrs | 1 Pax | 1 Leg | Basic Aeroplan
description:
Checks that the appeal flow only works for Closed cases. Flight AC 412 YUL ? YYZ arrived 7 hours late (Code 96, Controllable). DDS returns FD-APPR-EL-02, CAD 700. The customer leaves the chat before payment. Agent Sarah Martin sends Action Required with the secure payment link and parks the case (Awaiting Customer Info � Compensation). On Aug 12, day 11, the customer goes back to the chatbot, asks to appeal the case and quotes the case number. They give a reason and upload a document. The system sees that the case is Parked, not Closed, and refuses to accept it as an appeal. The bot tells the customer the case is still open and that their information has been added to it. The case goes to Update Pending Action with "?? UPDATE RECEIVED" for Sarah. There is no Re-opened state, no appeal flag, no appeal count, no "Appeal received" email, no new case and no reassignment. Sarah then finishes the case. The customer lives in Canada and picks Cash, so payment goes by Interac and only the email is collected.

Prerequisites:
PNR: PK003 � single passenger Laurence Gauthier (Adult, Basic Aeroplan 9876543210, good standing). AC 412 YUL ? YYZ, July 20, 2026. Scheduled arrival 12:00, actual 19:00 (7h delay). Code 96 (Operations Control � Controllable). Travelled, arrived late. No VOL/INVOL changes. AC only. Claim filed Jul 28, 2026. Case reference: CASE-FD-20260728-003. No duplicate. CyberSource GREEN. Country of residence: Canada. Owner agent: Sarah Martin (Available, not On Leave). Second agent: Marc Dubois (Available). Park date: Aug 1. Appeal attempt: Aug 12, 10:00 via chatbot. Maximum Appeals Allowed setting: configured (for example 1).
